references.text: Saul enters a cave to 'cover his feet' (the same Hebrew expression), which is a euphemism for relieving himself
The preceding verse describes how Ehud left the room and locked the doors behind him
The next verse continues the story of the servants who waited until they were ashamed before opening the doors
A reference to an 'upper room' (alijja), the same type of room that Eglon had as his private cool chamber
